data.title: 砂狼白子 · 便利店门前的运动饮料小憩
data.description: 烈日下街角静谧的便利店门前，白子的公路车斜靠在一旁。她单膝屈起坐在路肩水泥台阶上，额角渗出晶莹的汗珠，双手握着冰镇运动饮料罐贴在微热的脸颊上降温。她转动淡蓝眼眸静静注视着身旁的老师，眼神沉静而充满信任。
data.location: outside suburban convenience store sidewalk curb
data.action: sitting on concrete curb, holding cold drink can to cheek, bead of sweat, calm quiet gaze
data.lighting: bright midsummer sunlight with sharp cool shade under store awning
data.mood: quiet post-workout tranquility, relaxed companionship, and peaceful bond
data.promptProse: Resting on the curb outside a quiet convenience store after cycling, Sunaookami Shiroko presses a cold drink to her flushed cheek, looking forward with calm gentle eyes.
data.animaCaption: Shiroko sitting on the curb outside a convenience store holding a cold sports drink.
